invariants: No replacement empirical engine or alternate projection type is accepted by the runtime section.
Original-source configs may not use a fixture universe, fixture authority, synthetic ZZ/TEST_ONLY/default universe or fixture SHA.
Fixture configs require a distinct byte identity, explicit nonrespondent provenance and fixture-only authority snapshots.
The factory constructs respondent/value witnesses only when the physical cell stream is projected; preparation does not pre-invent them.
A configured source_native_key_slot is not silently ignored: row_native_keys must carry exact observed key witnesses after a permitted decode, or the factory refuses.
Native C11 validation remains the deciding validator; a loader, identity object, refusal or unexecuted recipe is not positive construction.
